_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. intercom.com declares its design layer on :root in @layer theme plus unlayered component vars, scoped sets on .theme-light, .brand-i2y4, .intercom-legacy and [data-media-player] (raw/css-vars.json); the semantic roles are read off the painted chrome in raw/components-computed.json. One theme (light).

$extensions.source: css-var --shadow-nav-light-menu (legacy scope: the old nav menu's drop shadow)

saans.value: Saans, "Saans Fallback", "Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN", "Hiragino Sans", "Yu Gothic UI", "Yu Gothic", Meiryo, "Noto Sans JP", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
saans.source: declared --font-sans = var(--font-Saans), var(--font-fallback-jp), … (@layer theme :root / .brand-i2y4); matches computed fontFamily of hero-title, nav, buttons and fields

serrif.value: Serrif, "Serrif Fallback", "Hiragino Mincho ProN", "Yu Mincho", "Noto Serif JP", ui-serif, Georgia, serif
serrif.source: declared --font-serif = var(--font-Serrif), var(--font-fallback-jp-serif), … (@layer theme :root / .brand-i2y4); Serrif faces declared in the font harvest, unloaded on captured pages

serrif-condensed.value: "Serrif Condensed", "Serrif Fallback", "Hiragino Mincho ProN", "Yu Mincho", "Noto Serif JP", ui-serif, Georgia, serif
serrif-condensed.source: declared --font-serif-condensed (.brand-i2y4); its variable class exists but no @font-face for it appeared in the harvest

saansmono.value: SaansMono, "SaansMono Fallback", "Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN", "Hiragino Sans", "Yu Gothic UI", "Yu Gothic", Meiryo, "Noto Sans JP", ui-monospace, monospace
saansmono.source: declared --font-mono = var(--font-SaansMono), var(--font-fallback-jp), … (@layer theme :root / .brand-i2y4); matches computed fontFamily of eyebrow ("TRUSTED BY 30,000+ LEADING BRANDS")

mediumll.value: MediumLL, "MediumLL Fallback", "Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN", "Hiragino Sans", "Yu Gothic UI", "Yu Gothic", Meiryo, "Noto Sans JP", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
mediumll.source: declared --font-sans = var(--font-MediumLL), … (.intercom-legacy); the older help/changelog surfaces

ivoryll.value: IvoryLL, "IvoryLL Fallback", "Hiragino Mincho ProN", "Yu Mincho", "Noto Serif JP", ui-serif, Georgia, serif

dmmono.value: DmMono, "DmMono Fallback", "Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN", "Hiragino Sans", "Yu Gothic UI", "Yu Gothic", Meiryo, "Noto Sans JP", ui-monospace, monospace

inter.value: Inter, "Inter Fallback", "Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN", "Hiragino Sans", "Yu Gothic UI", "Yu Gothic", Meiryo, "Noto Sans JP", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
inter.source: declared --font-Inter (:root) for the Japanese fallback stack

system.source: computed fontFamily of document.body (what the unbranded page ground paints)

page.source: --body-bg = var(--color-cream) (:root), the page ground; body itself paints transparent

card.source: header/nav and card surfaces paint white (measured header, nav-menu)

banner.source: computed promo-banner backgroundColor (the Fin 4 top banner's gray)

helpGround.source: computed body background of /changes/en (the older header__lite surface's ground)

primary.source: computed color of hero-title, nav, buttons, fields and footer = --color-off-black

onDark.source: computed color on the primary button = --color-white

muted.source: --color-gray-500, the muted copy step of the Tailwind ramp

link.source: computed nav-link/footer-link colour; links paint the primary ink

default.source: border-clay utility = --color-clay; plan cards and FAQ rules

subtle.source: computed feature-card border (black at 6% over the cream ground)

helpdesk.source: --color-helpdesk: the helpdesk-blue product accent (CTA hover, promo badge)
